GIDEP Integration Strengthens Quality Control and Defense Manufacturing Position

GIDEP is a cooperative information-sharing system managed by the Defense Standardization Program Office that connects U.S. government agencies with defense industrial suppliers. Participation grants Velo3D direct access to a centralized database containing technical, reliability, parts-obsolescence, and nonconformance data across tens of millions of part records, enabling higher supply-chain risk mitigation.

highlighted that GIDEP membership will directly complement Velo3D’s quality-control framework and defense manufacturing initiatives, which produce complex metal components for U.S. government applications using its Sapphire metal 3D-printing systems and Rapid Production Solutions.
Musk Comments Highlight High Tech Moat for Metal 3D Printing
Adding further momentum to Thursday’s price action,
SpaceX
CEO
Elon Musk
underscored the extreme technical barrier to entry behind advanced 3D metal printing in a post on
X

Responding to reports of a Chinese space company attempting to replicate SpaceX’s Raptor 3 engine, Musk cautioned against rival efforts, stating that while the engine appears simple externally, its internal structure contains complex geometry that “can only be manufactured using highly modified 3D metal printing.”
The post provides a tailwind for Velo3D, whose Sapphire metal additive manufacturing systems have long been leveraged across the aerospace sector to produce mission-critical rocket components.
